const sq = x => x*x;
function legPose(L, s_, c_, P){
  const h = P.hip * s_;
  const k = P.kneeBase + P.stanceKnee*sq(Math.max(0,-c_)) + P.kneeAmp*Math.pow(Math.max(0,c_), P.kneeExp);

  L.ankle.rotation.z = clamp(a, -0.85, 1.05);
}
